Emergency plumbers in Leeds, at your door within two hours

Northwind Plumbing is a family-run plumbing and heating company serving Leeds and the surrounding towns since 2009. We repair burst pipes, leaking radiators, broken boilers and blocked drains, and we do it on a fixed quote agreed before any work starts. Every engineer on our team is Gas Safe registered and carries the parts most jobs need, so the first visit is usually the only visit.

What we fix

  • Burst pipes and leaks — traced and repaired the same day.
  • Boiler repair and servicing — Worcester, Vaillant, Ideal and Baxi specialists.
  • Blocked drains — high-pressure jetting with a camera survey included.
  • Bathroom installation — from a single tap to a full refit.

Why Leeds households call us first

Our average response time across 2025 was 94 minutes, measured from the phone call to the engineer arriving. We publish that number every quarter because it is the thing customers ask about most. In the same year we completed 3,412 jobs and 96% of them were finished in a single visit.

Prices are fixed before we start. You will see the quote in writing, on your phone, and nothing changes unless you ask for extra work. Weekend and night call-outs cost the same as weekdays, which is unusual for the trade and something we are proud of.

Areas we cover

Leeds city centre, Headingley, Roundhay, Horsforth, Morley, Pudsey, Wetherby and Otley. If you are not sure whether we reach you, send us your postcode and we will confirm within the hour.

Trusted by 1,200 reviewers

We hold a 4.9-star average across 1,204 verified reviews on Checkatrade and Google. Read a selection on our about page, or ask us for references from your own street.
